title: A fine-looking cow, not a drop of milk
odia:
ଦେଖା ସୁନ୍ଦର ବଉଳା ଗାଈ
ଦୁହିଁଲା ବେଳକୁ ଟୋପାଏ ନାହିଁ।
literal_meaning: Baula the cow looks beautiful; when milked, not a drop [of milk].
meaning_odia: ବଉଳା ଗାଈ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ସୁନ୍ଦର, କିନ୍ତୁ ଦୁହିଁବା ବେଳେ ଟୋପାଏ କ୍ଷୀର ମଧ୍ୟ ମିଳୁନାହିଁ। ଦେଖାରୁ ହୋଇଥିବା ଭଲ ଧାରଣା ଓ କାମ ବେଳର ଫଳ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଏଠାରେ ଅମେଳ ଅଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ଏହା ବାହାର ଆକର୍ଷଣ ଦେଖି ଉପଯୋଗିତା ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରିବାକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
explanation: The first line invites admiration; the second puts that impression to a practical test and finds no milk. Our editorial reading concerns an attractive presentation that fails to deliver the expected result. Unlike an unspecified reservation about appearance, the verse states exactly what is missing.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A beautifully presented tool proves unable to perform its basic task. Someone compares it to the fine-looking cow that yields no milk.
cultural_context: Milking turns visual praise into a concrete test. The tiny measure ଟୋପାଏ, a single drop, makes the absence emphatic. Baula is retained as the cow’s designation without supplying a breed or a story about it.

witnesses.locator: Page25, seventh item beginning ଦେଖା ସୁନ୍ଦର ବଉଳା.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact two-line text retained. Baula is carried into English as a cow designation/name; no breed, colour or story identity inferred. Milk in the literal translation is supplied by the explicit milking context.

odia_summary: ଦେଖାର ଆକର୍ଷଣ ସତ୍ତ୍ୱେ ଆଶା କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଫଳ ମିଳୁନାହିଁ।
english_summary: An attractive appearance fails the test of the expected result.
